section_text: Examplestatin is indicated for the treatment of hypercholesterolemia and to reduce elevated LDL cholesterol in adults.
Contraindicated in patients with active liver disease or unexplained persistent transaminase elevations.
Ibuprofen is indicated for the relief of headache and mild to moderate pain.
Contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft surgery.
Omeprazole is indicated for the treatment of gastroesophageal reflux.
Dosage forms and strength information without a LOINC code.
